paras: Anolis marcanoi, also known commonly as Marcano's anole and the red-fanned stout anole, is a species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae. The species is endemic to the Dominican Republic.
The specific epithet, marcanoi, is in honor of Dominican botanist, entomologist, herpetologist, speleologist, and researcher Eugenio de Jesús Marcano Fondeur.
The preferred natural habitats of Anolis marcanoi are forest and shrubland, at altitudes of 200–1,800 m (660–5,910 ft).
